orders.name: Wexley Council Permits
orders.tagline: Parking permits for residents and businesses
orders.description: Apply for a parking permit, see your permits, or cancel one.
orders.purpose: People in Wexley apply for parking permits here. The form apply_permit takes plate, zone and kind. A plate is 5 to 8 letters and digits after spaces are removed, and it is kept in capital letters. A zone must be one of the zones in the public zone list. Kind is resident, which costs $30, or business, which costs $45. One vehicle can hold only one active permit in a zone, whoever applied: a second application for the same plate and zone is refused. A good application takes the fee from the saved card and gets the next reference, WP-0001, then WP-0002, counted from next_number in the public data. The page /permits lists the visitor's own permits with reference, plate, zone, kind, fee and whether each is active or cancelled. A person sees only their own permits. The form cancel_permit takes reference and cancels one of the visitor's own active permits. There is no refund. A reference that is not theirs is refused. The home page shows the zones and both fees.
